items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy.
lines: But one red car did... And nobody was driving.
And no, it isn't orbiting Earth. It never was.
Rewind to twenty eighteen. A new rocket's test flight needed a dummy load. Usually... concrete.
Elon Musk sent his cherry-red Roadster, driven by a spacesuit dummy... Starman.
[calm, deadpan, cool space-cowboy] Dashboard says don't panic. I'm not.
The rocket flung it out of Earth's grip. So where did it go?
Around the Sun. One loop every five hundred fifty-seven days, swinging out past Mars.
In twenty twenty, it passed Mars at about seven point four million kilometres.
Today it's about one hundred million kilometres away. The Moon's distance... two hundred sixty times.
Nearly six laps of the Sun. Its warranty? Thirty-six thousand miles. ...Claim denied.
Then it gets stranger. In twenty twenty-five, astronomers named a new asteroid near Earth.
[excited nerdy astronomer, then confused] New asteroid! ...Wait. It has seats?
A day later, it was deleted. It was the car.
To the Sun, a sports car is just another rock.
This month, Tesla showed a new Roadster. The first? Still out there.
The twist? It may come home... hitting Earth or Venus... in millions of years.
[calm, deadpan, cool space-cowboy] Running late. Back soon-ish.
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
